sword.description: An old sword strengthened by items directly beside it.

seal.description: Strengthens adjacent weapons. Diagonal cells do not count.

lantern.description: Lights the way for the belongings of the dead.

ring.description: A keepsake holding a final, unfulfilled promise.

hat.description: Blocks damage until the next enemy action. Its wide brim takes up space.

bell.description: A compact extra attack. It has no weapon tag and cannot receive talisman bonuses.

yakgwa.description: A one-use honey pastry. Once eaten, its space is freed permanently.

rope.description: A bent weapon. Rotate it to fit gaps and use adjacency bonuses.

sandals.description: A compact defense tool that leaves more room for other items.

order.description: A delivery order with a powerful attack that requires careful energy management.

coin.description: A keepsake that gives a little defense without spending energy.

mirror.description: A mirror found in the bamboo grove, holding someone's last memories.

mist_path.name: Follow the Bamboo Grove
mist_path.description: Meet Arang beyond the wind-swept bamboo grove.

moon_path.name: Pass the Moonlit Pond
moon_path.description: Pass the moonlit pond on your way to Arang.

lost_keepsake.title: Evidence in the Grove
lost_keepsake.description: A bloodstained mirror lies in the bamboo grove. Will you keep it as evidence?
lost_keepsake.take_result: You subdued Arang by force. The mirror remains, but her story was left untold.
lost_keepsake.leave_result: You subdued Arang by force. Her story remains untold.

evidence_resolution.message: Arang recognizes the mirror and begins to speak.
evidence_resolution.result: Arang recognizes the mirror and tells you what happened. You record her words and promise to reveal the truth. She nods and sets out on her own.
evidence_resolution.unavailable: Place the evidence in your bag to hear Arang's story.
